scope: Native multi-shard Safetensors index binding for the exact DeepSeek V4.1 Flash1017 EXL3 checkpoint. No numerical quant execution or native DeepSeek model admission yet.
api: BnSafetensorsIndex caller-owned opaque handle: transactional init/free, immutable global UTF-8 name lookup, tensor metadata/shard basename, checked byte reads. Reuses existing single-file storage reader; no global mutable state.

validation.failure_rollback: 200 repeated partial-open failures leave descriptor count unchanged; missing/wrong/duplicate/unindexed tensors, malformed manifests, byte totals and invalid basename paths reject. Existing initialized handles are preserved.

real_checkpoint.scope: Metadata and raw-byte ingestion only; no numerical EXL3 decoding or DeepSeek execution qualification.

randomized_sharded_files.scope: Random multi-shard indexes, physical/name ordering, Unicode filenames/names and packed/empty tensors; all bindings and full raw bytes match independent Python mapping and upstream Rust tensor decoding.

single_file_upstream_recheck.scope: Randomized dtype/shape/name/JSON-order/padding/packed/empty tensor files; all metadata and complete raw tensor bytes agree with upstream Rust deserialize. Explicit C API limits NULstrings/rank32/unknownfields are excluded.

component_binding.scope: EXL3 component/marker binding through native index. No quant numerical execution or model admission.

format_constraints: Index JSON has metadata.total_size and weight_map; unknown root/metadata fields reject explicitly.
All tensors in referenced shards must match the map exactly; unrelated files in the directory are ignored.
Shard entries are .safetensors basenames; slash/backslash path components reject. Ordinary filesystem symlink semantics apply.
At most4096shards and1048576tensors; existing100MBheader/rank32/NUL-string limits remain.
Header and payload byte integrity are checked structurally; tensor bodies were sampled, not fully hashed or numerically decoded.
next: Implement EXL3 MUL1 numerical behavior in the quant registry against an independent pinned source reference, then bind exact architecture/Engram/routing and bounded expert placement. Preserve all other modern-model/backend/performance requirements.
